scenarios.name: Full Canonical KYC Baseline
scenarios.description: Complete 50+ field KYC form across all categories. Used as the repeatable baseline for cross-stack comparison.

scenarios.name: Level 1 — Basic Text Inputs
scenarios.description: Tests fundamental single-line text, email, and phone input detection and value setting.

scenarios.name: Level 2 — Selection Controls
scenarios.description: Tests native dropdowns, radio buttons, checkboxes, and toggle-style controls.

scenarios.name: Level 2a — Dropdown & Selector Variations
scenarios.description: Tests native dropdowns, custom dropdowns, searchable combos, segmented controls, and duplicate selector fields.

scenarios.name: Level 2b — Radio Button Variations
scenarios.description: Tests inline radio groups, card-style radio selections, segmented controls, and duplicate radio groups.

scenarios.name: Level 2c — Checkbox & Toggle Variations
scenarios.description: Tests standard checkboxes, inline checkbox cards, toggle switches, and duplicate consent fields.

scenarios.name: Level 3 — Pickers, Comboboxes & Uploads
scenarios.description: Tests date pickers, searchable/select combos, and file upload widgets.

scenarios.name: Level 3a — Date Format Variations
scenarios.description: Tests date entry via different display formats (DD/MM/YYYY, MM/DD/YYYY, YYYY-MM-DD) as plain text inputs.

scenarios.name: Level 3b — Date Picker Widget Variations
scenarios.description: Tests native date pickers, manual day/month/year selectors, month/year inputs, and calendar-popup pickers.

scenarios.name: Level 3c — Document Upload Variations
scenarios.description: Tests native file inputs, drag-and-drop zones, multiple-file inputs, and camera-capture upload buttons.

scenarios.name: Level 3d — Combined Input Variations
scenarios.description: Mixes date formats, selectors, radios, checkboxes, toggles, and uploads in one form with duplicate same-type fields to test disambiguation.

scenarios.name: Level 4 — Dynamic Conditional Logic & Cascading Rules
scenarios.description: Tests dependent fields (spouse name on Married), cascading country/state/city, and live regex validation.

scenarios.name: Level 5 — Multi-step Wizards, Modals & Embedded Iframes
scenarios.description: Tests agent navigation across wizard steps, modal dialogs, side drawers, and iframe-embedded fields.

scenarios.name: Level 6 — Framework Shadow DOM & Web Components
scenarios.description: Tests Shadow DOM encapsulated inputs, custom web components, and framework-specific rendering idioms.

scenarios.name: Issue Variant — Combined Adversarial Stack
scenarios.description: Duplicate labels, fake buttons, hidden honeypots, dynamic IDs, and network delay applied together.

scenarios.name: Issue Variant — Duplicate Labels
scenarios.description: Non-unique labels force agents to use context, IDs, or surrounding text to disambiguate fields.

scenarios.name: Issue Variant — Dynamic IDs & Labels
scenarios.description: Element IDs and labels mutate on each page load; agents must rely on stable attributes or semantic selectors.

scenarios.name: Issue Variant — Fake Submit Buttons
scenarios.description: Decoy submit-styled buttons test whether the agent can identify the real submit control.

scenarios.name: Issue Variant — Hidden Honeypot Fields
scenarios.description: Invisible honeypot inputs must not be filled; visible required fields must still be completed correctly.

scenarios.name: Issue Variant — Network Latency
scenarios.description: Artificial API and rendering delay tests agent wait/retry behavior.

scenarios.name: Issue Variant — Shadow DOM Encapsulation
scenarios.description: Critical inputs live inside Shadow Roots; agents must pierce or interact with the encapsulation boundary.

scenarios.name: Level 7 — Adversarial Stress Conditions
scenarios.description: Tests agent resilience against duplicate labels, decoy buttons, network delays, hidden honeypot fields, and dynamic IDs.
